_about: T.S.R.A. Field Clearance: the player's rank with the agency, raised by the XP that the field scanner files on every new reading (scripts/GameLogicEngine/tsra_clearance.gd). tiers: the ranks in order, each reached once lifetime XP hits its "yield"; "code" and "title" are what the player sees ("RANK 3", "INVESTIGATOR"); "color" is the rank's colour everywhere it shows; "effects" are what its name does on the rank-up stamp (xp_popup.gd: glow, shine, wave, pulse, flicker), more the higher it is; "brief" is the line the promotion notice shows. A tier may grant an "unlock" ({id, name, text}) that stays on from that tier up; the game checks it with Clearance.has_unlock(id): classified (the CLASSIFIED ANNEX in the dossiers), rangefinder (the scanner's signal range and bearing), deep_scan (a locked reading reports what the anomaly is doing right now). The yield rules themselves (what a reading is worth and its modifiers) live in the script's constants.

tiers.title: RECRUIT
tiers.brief: Onboarding in progress. Field scanner issued on a probationary licence.

tiers.title: TRAINEE
tiers.brief: First readings received. The agency has started a file on you.

tiers.title: FIELD AGENT
tiers.brief: Probation lifted. Scanner calibration patch pushed to your unit.

tiers.title: SURVEYOR
tiers.brief: Your readings now count toward agency quotas. Redacted material is released to you.

unlock.name: CLASSIFIED ANNEXES
unlock.text: Redacted dossier and entry sections are now readable: origins, survival protocols, incident reports.

tiers.title: SCOUT
tiers.brief: You are trusted to walk ahead of the teams now. Few come back to report it.

tiers.title: TRACKER
tiers.brief: Cross-level telemetry access granted. Your scanner has been upgraded.

unlock.name: SCANNER RANGE-FINDER
unlock.text: While searching, the scanner now reports how far away a signal is and which way to turn.

tiers.title: INVESTIGATOR
tiers.brief: You are now cleared for unescorted deep-level survey.

unlock.name: DEEP SCAN
unlock.text: A locked reading now reports what the anomaly is doing right now, and whether it is after you.

tiers.title: ANALYST
tiers.brief: Your readings are now cited in other surveyors' briefings.

tiers.title: SPECIALIST
tiers.brief: The agency assigns you the anomalies nobody else will take.

tiers.title: SENIOR SPECIALIST
tiers.brief: Your name is on the training material. Recruits are told to listen to you.

tiers.title: INSPECTOR
tiers.brief: You audit other teams' logs now. Some of them describe rooms that are not there.

tiers.title: SUPERVISOR
tiers.brief: You sign off other teams' routes. If they don't come back, it is on your desk.

tiers.title: CHIEF
tiers.brief: Dossier authorship rights granted. Your findings set directive policy.

tiers.title: COMMANDER
tiers.brief: Whole survey teams deploy on your word. Count them out. Count them back.

tiers.title: OVERSEER
tiers.brief: You see the survey maps before they are drawn. Some of them are already wrong.

tiers.title: DEPUTY DIRECTOR
tiers.brief: One seat from the board. The board has not been seen in person for some time.

tiers.title: DIRECTOR
tiers.brief: One door left. Nobody you have met has walked through it.

tiers.title: THE BOARD
tiers.brief: There is no higher rank. There is no way back up. Welcome to the board.
